component.name: Rafiq
رفيق المسلم
component.summary: Muslim companion — morning/evening adhkar, prayer counter, favorites

description.p: Rafiq (رفيق المسلم) is an offline Muslim companion app. It provides morning and evening adhkar from bundled, authentic sources, a prayer counter (tasbih), favorites, and search — all in Arabic with a clean green/off-white interface.

ul.li: Morning and evening adhkar with source attribution
Fully offline — no account, no analytics, no ads
